overall_comment: The combination of very young patient age and a large, non-enhancing, infiltrative tumor involving deep gray matter strongly suggests an IDH-mutant astrocytoma. The absence of enhancement argues against grade 4, while the significant size and mass effect make grade 3 more likely than grade 2.
